versions.changelog:
Website Migration Orchestrator 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces an end-to-end orchestration skill for migrating entire business websites to a new platform, supporting both 1:1 UI replication and redesign.
- Preserves original site SEO value with automatic URL mapping and 301 redirection handling.
- Conducts structured migration through 19 pipeline stages, from old site analysis to new site go-live and post-migration checks.
- Enforces strict pre-requisite checks: dependency skill installation, copyright and ownership confirmation, and form-based unified user input collection.
- Integrates seamlessly with external builder, SEO, and GEO tools via a defined dependency installation and invocation protocol.
